answers.question: 171/00 Q1 · When you select a shape, should the on-canvas action offer only "Add note", or also "Ask architect" (records the note and starts or feeds the architect's session at once)? Only "Add note" keeps the canvas chrome small; both saves a trip to the bar below the canvas when you want an answer now.
answers.answer: Only ask architect. Adding notes should be through the editor

answers.question: 171/04 Q1 · When you start the architect session from the editor, should notes already waiting be sent to it straight away? Today Ask architect sends only the question you just typed, and waiting notes need "Review N notes". Sending them means one session covers everything open; not sending means it answers only what you asked.
